assertion: Named SVG filter inputs form reusable branches with blur, offset, flood, merge, blend, arithmetic composite, matrix, transfer, morphology, displacement and drop shadow. Filter/primitive regions and default linearRGB are honored.

browser.reason: All three browsers were inspected. Chrome is closest for this graph after explicit named displacement input; WebKit differs in semitransparent source composition. Remaining differences are Gaussian kernel approximation, displacement resampling, fractional subregion clipping and edge antialiasing. Independent GPU tests assert linear/sRGB compositing, aliased inputs, empty-source generation and clipping.
